Safe Space Agreement

Please review our neighborhood code of conduct and guidelines.

1. Detailed Code of Conduct

Be respectful, kind, and honest with your neighbors. We have a zero-tolerance policy for objectionable content or abusive users. Any harassment, discrimination, illicit substances, dangerous behavior, or offensive postings will result in immediate permanent suspension from the platform. The listing of illegal goods, weapons, drugs, and adult services is strictly prohibited.

2. Terms of Service

Access to and use of Corner Swaps is subject to these terms. Users must provide accurate profile details. You agree not to list illegal goods, weapons, prescription drugs, or adult services. You agree to use the service in compliance with all local laws and municipal guidelines.

3. Privacy Policy

We collect your personal information and approximate location details to connect you with nearby neighbors. Coordinates are fuzzed by 200–300 meters to safeguard your privacy. We never sell your data, and you can delete your account and personal information at any time.

4. End User License Agreement (EULA)

We grant you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to use the Corner Swaps application. You retain ownership of content you post, but grant us a worldwide license to display it. Objectionable content or behavior is strictly prohibited, and we reserve the right to remove any content or terminate user accounts that violate this agreement.

5. Exchange Safety Guidelines

Always arrange exchanges in safe, public, and well-lit locations (such as local parks, cafes, or community centers). Only share cross-streets or general vicinities; never share your exact home address or apartment number.

6. Liability Disclaimer

All trades are at your own risk. Corner Swaps helps neighbors connect, but we do not verify or guarantee the safety or quality of items or services shared. By using the app, you release the platform from personal disputes or swapping mishaps.

Definitions & Guidance

volunteer_activism Karma

Karma points reflect your active contributions, reliability, and good standing in the community. You earn karma and XP by completing neighborhood actions. Higher karma highlights you as a trusted neighbor and unlocks special badges!

XP & Karma Point Formula:

List an offer/item: +10 XP

Create an event/meetup: +10 XP

Complete standard swap: +5 XP

Complete a Karma swap (gift): +10 XP / +50 Karma Points

Submit a swap review: +10 XP

Positive swap rating received: +10 Karma Points

Negative swap rating received: -10 Karma Points

handshake Swaps

Completed Swaps track the total number of items or services you have successfully swapped with other neighbors.

volunteer_activism Gifts

Gift listings are offered for free out of neighborly kindness. Giving or sharing for free earns you extra karma points, highlighting you as a trusted neighbor!

groups Groups

Make group chats by adding friends for recurring exchanges, such as regular book swaps, food exchanges, or skill shares.

schedule Time sensitive

Make swaps within 48 hours, so we are respecting neighbours time. If a swap is not made in 48 hours, the chat will be deleted.

chat Chats

Once a swap is made, chats are deleted. You can save a listing if you would like to go back to it, but aren’t ready to swap yet.

money_off Cashless

We ask that all swaps are made without money. We support a neighbourhood economy that is based on giving.

school Skill shares and expertise

Everyone is good at something! Consider adding skills shares or expertise to your offerings. These are skills you can share lessons on, or areas you can provide knowledgeable guidance or tips.

Neighbourhood Tips

volunteer_activism Lead by Giving

Every listing you share builds your public neighborhood trust rating and inspires others to trade. Start by putting out what you can share!

lightbulb Ideas on What to Offer

You can share a wide range of offerings: lend tools and appliances to reduce waste, offer lessons or tutoring services, share professional advice, organize community playdates, or trade items you no longer need.

volunteer_activism Karma

Karma listings are items that are given away for free. Giving to your neighbors is a great way to support the community and earns you extra Karma points!

security Tips for safe meet ups

Always meet in well-lit public spaces, share nearby cross-streets instead of your exact home address, remember that swaps are entirely cashless, and immediately report any safety concerns in chat.

🛡️ Safety and Security

  • Verify Profiles: Always trade with community members who have verified badges and higher vouch counts.
  • Public Meetups: Conduct swaps during daylight hours in busy, well-lit public areas (e.g., local coffee shops or community centers).
  • Secure Communication: Keep all discussions inside the Barterland secure chat; never share your phone number or email early on.
  • Share Your Location: Let a friend or family member know where and when you are going to meet someone for a swap.
  • Address Privacy: Meet at nearest major cross-streets rather than giving out your home address, especially for high-value swaps.
  • Trust Your Instincts: If a deal feels suspicious or uncomfortable, cancel the meetup immediately and report the user in-app.

Help Us Improve

Have feedback, found an issue, or have ideas for new features? Let us know below! Your suggestions go directly to our product and design teams.

info How we use your feedback

Corner Swaps is built for the neighborhood, by the neighborhood. We read every single submission and use them to shape future updates.

  • Suggestions: Help us refine the user experience, layout, colors, and overall application flow.
  • Bug Reports: Please describe what you were doing, what went wrong, and what device you are currently on.
  • Feature Pitches: Explain how your idea helps the neighborhood connect or swap items.
Need urgent support? support@cornerswaps.com

2. Assumption of Risk

By listing or requesting any skill exchange, the lister acknowledges that the platform assumes no liability for injuries, physical damages, property loss, accidents, or unmet expectations resulting from this in-person exchange.

3. Mutual Care & Release

Neighbors agree to release the platform and each other from claims, liability, or demands. Please inspect descriptions and communicate clearly before meetups.
